in_hebrew.name: Albur
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Noble or Exalted One

in_latin.name: Albur
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Noble or Exalted One
in_latin.long_meaning: Albur est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old German name 'Alahbur' or 'Alabohr', meaning 'Noble' or 'Exalted One'. In Christian spirituality, this name represents a strong sense of dignity, courage, and faith.
